story_text:
## Your home's intelligence shouldn't have to sit on a countertop.
Or a nightstand. Or a bookshelf. Or wherever else you found room for the last smart speaker you bought.
NoorLight™ is a 4-inch smart recessed downlight that brings smart lighting, synchronized multiroom audio, voice interaction, and AI conversational assistance (Noor AI subscription required) together in a distributed intelligent platform that starts in the ceiling—and is designed to extend far beyond it.
Instead of filling every room with separate smart speakers and devices, NoorLight makes the intelligence part of the home itself.
And this isn't just an idea. NoorLight™ is built on patented technology developed by Noorall Technologies, with additional patent applications covering the broader technology and intelligent platform behind the system.
Our working prototype already demonstrates the core lighting, multiroom audio, voice interaction, and conversational AI capabilities behind the NoorLight experience. Our campaign video combines conceptual demonstrations of NoorLight's vision with authentic footage of our working prototype, showcasing the core capabilities we've already developed.
The prototype housing shown is larger than the planned production version, which is being engineered as a 4-inch recessed downlight.
## What NoorLight™ delivers
## Smart lighting
Control brightness and color throughout your space from the NoorLight app, with the included NoorLight wall control, or by voice through Noor AI (subscription required).
## Synchronized multiroom audio
Play and control audio across multiple NoorLight fixtures, bringing sound into the same ceiling infrastructure that already provides your lighting.
## "Hey Noor," powered by Noor AI (subscription required)
Built-in microphones bring Noor's intelligent assistant directly into the NoorLight system, allowing you to speak naturally instead of memorizing rigid commands.
"Hey Noor, turn off the downstairs lights."
"Hey Noor, set the living room to warm white."
"Hey Noor, play music everywhere."
And Noor AI goes beyond controlling lights and music. Ask questions, request explanations, continue with follow-up questions, and learn something new from wherever you are in the home.
"Hey Noor, why does water turn into steam?"
"Hey Noor, explain that another way."
"Hey Noor, how do I find the area of a circle?"
"Hey Noor, quiz me on that."
Noor AI is a planned, optional subscription-based intelligent assistant. Wake-word detection for "Hey Noor" is designed to run locally on the fixture, while requests requiring intelligent processing may use established AI services.
See the FAQ for subscription details.
## NoorLight Speaks Your Language
Intelligence should feel at home in every language.
Noor AI is being designed to support multiple languages, including English, Arabic, and French, with plans to introduce additional languages as the platform evolves.
From everyday conversations and learning to managing your connected spaces, our vision is to make Noor AI a natural, accessible experience that continues to grow with you.
Noor AI is planned to launch initially in English, with Arabic and French support to follow as development progresses. Additional languages are planned for future releases.
## Control NoorLight your way
Use NoorLight's built-in microphones for hands-free voice interaction through Noor AI (subscription required).
Use the NoorLight app for direct control of lighting and audio from your phone. The NoorLight app will be available at no additional charge at launch.
Every NoorLight fixture reward includes one NoorLight wall control, designed to provide direct physical lighting control while allowing the NoorLight system to remain powered and connected even when the light itself is off.
A dedicated NoorLight remote is also planned as a separately purchased accessory, providing simple, direct control without needing to reach for a phone.
## Designed in pairs
NoorLight™ is offered in pairs because the experience is better together.
Multiple fixtures provide a fuller, more immersive audio experience while distributing lighting, voice interaction, and intelligent assistance throughout the space.
That's why every NoorLight fixture reward begins with two fixtures, with 4-Pack and 6-Pack options for larger spaces and multiple rooms.
The more NoorLight becomes part of the home, the more the distributed experience comes to life.
See our FAQ for installation, power requirements, and shipping availability.
## And that's only the beginning.
NoorLight™ is being designed as an expandable platform that can grow into a broader connected-home ecosystem through additional Noor hardware and software, bringing more intelligent capabilities together throughout homes, businesses, and beyond.
Intelligent sensing, where it makes sense (Planned)
NoorLight's distributed architecture is designed to allow optional sensors to be incorporated where needed, with information shared across the system.
For example, a kitchen with four NoorLight fixtures may need only one strategically positioned motion sensor to support occupancy-based lighting.
Rather than requiring every fixture to have every sensor, NoorLight is designed to let information from one location help multiple fixtures respond intelligently.
Intelligent sensing is a planned future capability and is not included in the NoorLight fixture rewards offered in this Kickstarter campaign.
Future capabilities could allow interactions such as:
"Hey Noor, set the temperature to 72°."
"Hey Noor, is the garage door still open?"
"Hey Noor, lower the living room shades to 50%."
"Hey Noor, find a French bakery near me."
"Hey Noor, find a computer repair shop nearby and text me a few options."
These broader connected-home and task-assistance capabilities are part of NoorLight's planned future expansion and are not included with the fixture rewards offered in this Kickstarter campaign. Additional Noor hardware, software, or services may be required and offered separately.
The standard 4-inch recessed NoorLight™ is the model offered in this Kickstarter campaign. Children's themed designs, educational versions, and hanging fixtures are planned future concepts and are not included in Kickstarter rewards. Optional camera and motion-sensing features shown in conceptual images are also not included.
## Throughout the Home — and Beyond.
From living rooms and children's bedrooms to schools, offices, hotels, and businesses, we envision NoorLight bringing intelligent lighting, audio, and connected experiences into spaces of every kind.
Our goal is bigger than putting another smart device in your home.
It's to make the home itself—and the spaces beyond it—more intelligent.
NoorLight™
The Intelligent Home Starts in the Ceiling.
risks: NoorLight™ is an ambitious hardware and software project that combines smart lighting, synchronized multiroom audio, voice interaction, and AI conversational assistance in a compact architectural fixture. As with any new connected hardware product, there are risks involving final engineering, component availability, manufacturing, product qualification and certification, software development, and production scheduling. These factors could result in design changes or delays. We have already developed working prototypes that demonstrate the core lighting, multiroom audio, voice interaction, and conversational AI capabilities behind the NoorLight experience. We are continuing engineering and testing while beginning discussions with manufacturing partners. Kickstarter funding will help move NoorLight through final engineering, product qualification and certification, manufacturing preparation, and initial production. Noor AI may use one or more established third-party AI and cloud services. Changes to those services, their availability, capabilities, terms, or costs could affect Noor AI features or service pricing over time. Noor AI is being designed with the flexibility to work with more than one provider, allowing us to adapt as services change. Our March 2028 estimated delivery reflects our current engineering and manufacturing plan, but hardware development schedules can change during final engineering, qualification, certification, and production. If challenges affect the schedule or the features planned for the initial release, we will communicate those changes clearly and promptly with our backers.

faq.q: How is NoorLight different from a traditional smart light or smart speaker?
faq.a: Rather than adding separate smart speakers and devices throughout the home, NoorLight is designed to integrate these capabilities into the architectural lighting itself. Multiple NoorLight fixtures can work together as part of a distributed system throughout the home.

"Hey Noor" is the voice interface for the NoorLight system, powered by Noor AI. It allows natural voice interaction for lighting, music, information, learning, and other intelligent-assistant functions. Noor AI is a planned, a planned, a planned, optional subscription-based service. The NoorLight app and the included wall control can be used without a subscription.

faq.q: Is NoorLight™ already a working product?
faq.a: Working prototypes have been developed and engineering and testing are continuing. Kickstarter funding will help support final engineering, product qualification, manufacturing preparation, and initial production.

NoorLight™ is designed to provide a voice-assistant experience similar to Alexa or Siri, except instead of relying on a separate smart speaker sitting on a kitchen counter, table, or shelf, the experience is built into the home through the ceiling. Voice interaction is powered by Noor AI and requires a subscription.

NoorLight™ is designed for recessed ceiling installation and operates on 24V DC power.

Each NoorLight fixture includes its own 110–220V AC to 24V DC power supply, supporting common household electrical systems in the U.S. and many international markets.

Unlike conventional recessed lights, NoorLight remains powered even when the lighting is turned off, keeping its audio, connectivity, and intelligent features available.
